title: Computational weather / brain damage
_no_contract_was_frozen: No verdict contract was hashed and no organism was evaluated under a frozen criterion. Every number here comes from the admissibility gate and its diagnostic probes, not from EXECUTE.
why_inconclusive_and_not_null: NULL would be a claim about the WORLD: that weather-evolved lineages exist, were damaged, recovered, and showed no advantage. None of that happened. The pre-QUALIFY gate refused the world twice, so no lineage was ever evolved under weather and the causal comparison was never posed. PREREGISTRATION section 11 defines INCONCLUSIVE as exactly this case.

decision_budget.run_1: REFUSED on P1 and P4; gate credibility 5/5 fixtures refused for the expected predicate (GATE_E07_run1.json)
decision_budget.correction: ONE causal feature: lifetimes_per_eval 2 -> 8 (Amendment 2), chosen from probes A-G as the only single feature that moved state use toward reachability
decision_budget.run_2: REFUSED on P1 and P4; gate credibility 5/5 again (GATE_E07.json)
decision_budget.closed: no third world-design cycle, per the budget

P1_damage_fires._reading: damage fires measurably (rho0 0.80, F1 no-op fixture gives exactly 1.000) but the preregistered magnitude on AURC is unattainable at f=0.20 for the reference probe; attainable only at f >= 0.44 (probe A). CW01-D058.

P2_sham_inert._reading: sham lifetimes are bit-identical to intact; bookkeeping neutrality (layer 3) holds

P3_non_lethal._reading: passes VACUOUSLY: nothing is lost because the pilot organisms barely use state (median AURC at f=0.30 is 0.98 in run 2). A P3 pass under D059 is not evidence of a recoverable regime.

P4_separable._reading: organisms of like intact ability do not differ in damage response beyond retest noise, because damage barely bites on any of them (D059)

P5_blind._reading: the production selector is representation- and semantic-blind; the magnitude-targeting fixture F5 was refused

learnability._reading: a hand-built organism achieves the effect; the world is learnable in principle, unreachable by this search

gate_results.determinism: pilot lineage 0 evolved twice from attempt_id alone: bit-identical

gate_credibility.fixtures_refused: 5/5 in both runs, each for the expected predicate
gate_credibility.F1_noop_selector: P1 fired (AURC exactly 1.000 in every block)
gate_credibility.F3_persistent_lesion: P3 fired (median AURC 0.0, nothing recovers) and P1's stateless check also fired, correctly: a lesion after the update touches a stateless organism
gate_credibility.F4_readout_gain_family: P4 fired (damage response a deterministic function of intact ability)
gate_credibility.F5_magnitude_selector: P5 fired (index set differs across states)
gate_credibility._rule: the gate was never relaxed to admit; both refusals are recorded as findings

what_was_achieved.science_fixed_before_code: PREREGISTRATION.md at 836023206: one damage family, a bit-identical cost-matched sham, three arms with SHAMWEATHER as a mechanically defined M3, lineage as the unit, an exact relabelling null, and an ability-adjusted decisive statistic (AURC normalised per organism by its own intact capability, with intact score as a covariate and an overlap requirement) so intact ability cannot masquerade as robustness in either direction.
what_was_achieved.cheap_admissibility_before_evolution: The gate cost ~2 s per run and refused the world before a single lineage was evolved under weather; the full EXECUTE would have burned 96 lineages to reach the same INCONCLUSIVE.
what_was_achieved.gate_with_teeth: Five known-broken fixtures refused for the right reason, twice, with the fixture set corrected pre-data (Amendment 1) when two of the originals turned out not to be valid known-broken cases.
what_was_achieved.three_layer_neutrality: Reward never mentions damage (layer 1); task stream keyed independently of the weather stream (layer 2); sham bit-identical to intact and one representative-selection rule for all arms (layer 3, P2 PASS).
what_was_achieved.measure_before_theorising: Seven probes (A-G, ~4 s total) refuted my own meltdown hypothesis (the trajectory swings are theta-draw noise), established the P1 attainability curve, and eliminated diagonal recurrence, mutation scale and initial scale as single-feature fixes before the one correction was spent.

what_was_not_achieved.damage_never_bit_an_evolved_organism: CW01-D059: evolution reaches intact score 0.35-0.45 against the accumulator's 0.74 and uses state for ~0.05-0.09 of its score at both the pilot and the real budget.
what_was_not_achieved.P1_magnitude_unattainable_as_preregister: CW01-D058: the 0.90 AURC bound needs f >= 0.44 for the reference probe; frozen without an attainability computation and, correctly, not moved after observing results.
what_was_not_achieved.no_weather_lineage_was_evolved: M1, M2, M3 and controls A-C were never exercised. The decisive statistic has no referent.

limitations_and_residuals: CW01-D061 (class C): the usefulness rule admits near-floor organisms whose per-window ratios explode; contained by the clip, not removed.

The gate's P3 is satisfiable in the absence of the phenomenon when damage does not bite (CW01-D034 family); a future P3 should be gated on P1 having fired on the population under test, not only on the hand-built probe.
One organism family (464-parameter linear recurrent net), one search regime, four pilot lineages, one attempt_id.
what_a_future_attempt_would_need: Attainability computed BEFORE freezing: place P1's magnitude on rho_0 (0.80 at f=0.20 here), or preregister f >= 0.44 as primary, with the reference probe's curve on record.

An organism or search in which the accumulator ridge is reachable: e.g. persistence as a bounded per-cell gene a in [0,1] with the input gain tied to (1-a) so the move is one-dimensional, or a search budget an order of magnitude larger; verified by the SAME cheap pilot before the preregistration is frozen.
P3 gated on P1 having fired on the pilot population itself.

Keep everything else: the damage family, the bit-identical sham, the SHAMWEATHER M3 arm, the relabelling null, the ability-adjusted statistic and the fixture set all held up and are reusable as written.
doctrine_promoted: A preregistered magnitude threshold must come with its attainable range for the reference probe, computed before freezing; otherwise the gate can refuse a world for an arithmetic reason that no causal correction can fix, and the one-correction budget is spent on the wrong defect. This is the eligibility-count lesson (CW01-D043 family) applied to gate thresholds rather than to selection rules.
